basic_details.job_title: CSIR IMTECH Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology, Sector 39-A, Chandigarh, has one Project Associate-I (PAT-I) position under project GAP-0269 (ENDOCORE PROTECT), advertised in Rolling Advt. No. 2026-11-02. Monthly emoluments are Rs.31,000 + HRA for NET/GATE-qualified candidates and Rs.25,000 + HRA for others. The upper age limit is 35 years, and the essential qualification is a Master's degree in the listed sciences or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or Medicine.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 35 years. The notice prints no "as on" date for counting age. rows.details: CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology, Sector 39-A, Chandigarh-160036
ENDOCORE PROTECT-Harnessing core and vertically transmitted endophytes for multi-factorial bio-protection against major pathogens of rice and sugarcane (Project Code: GAP-0269)
Rs.31,000 + HRA or Rs.25,000 + HRA (see Pay section)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology is located at Sector 39-A, Chandigarh. This post is attached to the project titled "ENDOCORE PROTECT", which concerns core and vertically transmitted endophytes for multi-factorial bio-protection against major pathogens of rice and sugarcane. The notice is signed by the Administrative Officer.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of this position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Masters or Integrated Masters in Natural or Agricultural or Pharmaceutical Sciences, MVSc, or Animal Sciences, or equivalent, from a recognised university. OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience in handling microbes, molecular identification, phenotypic characterization and preservation. Experience in molecular biology techniques, i.e. DNA isolation, RNA isolation, PCR, RT-PCR, Sanger sequencing, microbial genomics, etc. The upper age limit is 35 years. The notice prints no "as on" date for counting age. Relaxation is 5 years for candidates in the SC, ST, PwBD and Women categories, and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is printed as an addition to both pay figures. The notice does not state the tenure of the post.

rows.category_of_candidate: Candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including lectureship/assistant professorship, or GATE, OR who have qualified national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions
Others who do not fall under the first category

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Result awaited candidates are not eligible to apply. In case of any dispute, the English version of the notice will prevail.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I (PAT-I)?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 position of Project Associate-I (PAT-I) under project code GAP-0269.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A Masters or Integrated Masters in Natural, Agricultural or Pharmaceutical Sciences, MVSc or Animal Sciences or equivalent, OR a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there age relaxation for CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Yes. Relaxation is 5 years for SC, ST, PwBD and Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Rs.31,000 plus HRA for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET or GATE or the listed national level examinations, and Rs.25,000 plus HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Both amounts are printed as "+HRA", so HRA is shown in addition to Rs.31,000 and Rs.25,000.

faq.question: Q7. Can result awaited candidates apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that result awaited candidates are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Which project is this post under?
faq.answer: The post is under the project "ENDOCORE PROTECT-Harnessing core and vertically transmitted endophytes for multi-factorial bio-protection against major pathogens of rice and sugarcane", Project Code GAP-0269.
